Set the bottom-left corner of the grid at \((0,0)\). Since each grid square has area \(1\), its side length is \(1\), so the grid spans from \(x=0\) to \(5\) and \(y=0\) to \(4\).

The shaded polygon is a parallelogram with vertices
\[
(0,0),\quad (2,3),\quad (5,4),\quad (3,1).
\]
Using vertex \((0,0)\), the two adjacent side vectors are
\[
(2,3)\quad\text{and}\quad(3,1).
\]
The area of a parallelogram is the absolute value of the determinant of these two vectors:
\[
\text{Area}=\left|2\cdot 1-3\cdot 3\right|
=|2-9|=7.
\]

\[
